notes:
Mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics) evaluating Redwood. Started with Hosted API trial (marketing site + in-app support bot). Team: 2 product leads, 1 infra eng, 1 security. Wants predictable latency for support flows and cheaper unit economics for high-volume doc-search reranking. Key quote from CTO: "We need ~<250ms p95 for quick help replies, but can tolerate longer for long-form summaries."

Shorthand/CRM-style:
- Hosted trial (Feb) -> integrated chat widget + reranker pipeline.
- Observed model quality OK; cost spiky on long summaries.
- Security: must present SOC2 evidence + SSO, data residency for EU customers.
- Interested in Dedicated to reduce per-token cost and guarantee concurrency.
- Wants quantized 7B/13B family recommendations + fallback smaller model for overflow.

Customer sentiment: cautious but motivated by cost savings and SLOs. AE notes: keep pricing pathway simple; propose 12-month commit if we meet 20% cost reduction target.

poc_outcomes: Hosted API trial (2 weeks active): ~3k DAU interacting with chat widget; 30k monthly requests across features
Observed metrics: p95 latency short queries = 220ms (hosted), cold-starts up to 800ms for long-context runs
Token mix observed: 60% short support messages (~150 tokens total), 25% doc-search/rerank (~300 tokens), 15% long-form summaries (~1200 tokens)
Cost: hosted per-1M-token spend higher than internal target by ~28% on long-summary-heavy days
Quality: preferred 13B-family for accuracy on rerank/summary; 7B acceptable for short chat with caching
traffic_forecast: Peak day forecast: 8am-10am local: 120 QPS sustained for 10 minutes; typical peak 40-60 QPS
Concurrency target: plan for 50 concurrent active user streams (chat sessions) during peak
Desired latency SLOs: <=250ms p95 for short queries, <=1.2s p95 for long summaries
dedicated_sizing_recommendation: Initial recommended reserved footprint: 4 x A10G-equivalent GPUs (baseline) with autoscale buffer of 1 extra GPU for spikes
Rationale: baseline throughput target ~80-120 QPS for short chat models when using optimized 7B quantized kernels
Concurrency per GPU (expected): ~12-20 concurrent short-chat streams (depends on batching); long-form generation reduces concurrency to 4-6 per GPU
KV cache: 2 small cache nodes to serve prefix cache for common support prompts -> reduces token compute ~18%
Fallback policy: route overflow to smaller 3B quantized pool (burst) to preserve SLOs; enable regional fallback to reduce latency for EU users
Storage/egress note: EU data residency required for ~25% of traffic; recommend VPC peering + egress plan in proposal
pricing_notes: Customer expects ~20% cost reduction vs hosted with 12-month reserved commit
Asks: pricing on 12-month vs 24-month commit, burst capacity pricing, overage rates
Suggested commercial: 12-month reserved + 3-month ramp credit; include SRE onboarding hours in contract
Estimated ARR with contract: $50k-$120k depending on commitment and add-ons (observability retention, enterprise SLAs)
technical_requirements: Audit logging + 1 year retention for production traces
KMS integration for customer-managed keys for token logs
VPC deployment or dedicated tenant for Dedicated (no shared tenancy for sensitive workloads)
